description: UK government open datasets from the data.gov.uk catalogue (CKAN API): title, publisher, licence, last modified date, number of resources and dataset link, for a search term. Catalogue metadata only, not the data files themselves. Related tools on this server, for a different need: gov_governmentbids when you need open US/Canadian government bid solicitations listed; gov_govdeals when you need live US government surplus auctions on GovDeals. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: gov_data_gov_uk
